failure_modes.recovery: Resend with a listed doc_type and a next_number of at least next_number_min; send invoice and quote prefixes with sales_settings_upsert instead.
failure_modes.when: doc_type is not listed; next_number is not a whole number from 1 to 999999999, or is not above the last number used or skipped (the error carries last_number and next_number_min); prefix is not 1-10 letters, digits, . _ / or -, or is sent for invoice or quote; or neither next_number nor prefix is sent

failure_modes.recovery: The owner approves the pending action in the app; nothing changes until then. Tell the owner and do not retry.
failure_modes.when: an agent calls it: a numbering change is permanent

failure_modes.recovery: Tell the owner (the fix is an owner step). Invoice and quote numbering still work.
failure_modes.when: doc_type is credit_note, debit_note or receipt and this environment has not set those counters up yet (SIMPLER_SALES_NUMBERING_SERIES_UNMIGRATED)

preconditions: sales_settings_numbering_read shows each type's next_number and next_preview: read it first and send a next_number at or above the next_number it shows.
A set cannot be undone: numbers below the new next number are never issued.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Sets where a document type's numbers continue, for example after moving from another invoicing tool. doc_type: invoice, quote, credit_note, debit_note or receipt. next_number is the sequence number the next document gets (42 prints as INV-2026-042). Numbering only moves forward: a number at or below the last one used or skipped is refused with VALIDATION_ERROR naming that number, and nothing changes. prefix sets the credit_note, debit_note or receipt prefix; invoice and quote prefixes are invoice_prefix and quote_prefix on sales_settings_upsert. An agent call waits for the owner's approval. Read the current numbers with sales_settings_numbering_read.

doc_type.description: Which document type's numbering to change.

next_number.description: The sequence number the next document of this type gets. Must be above the last number used or skipped.

prefix.description: credit_note, debit_note or receipt only: 1-10 letters or digits (plus . _ / -), printed before the year.

name: sales_settings_numbering_set
